WITH state_accounts AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(c.state_county_province, 'No State') AS state,
    COUNT(*) AS account_count
  FROM Accounts a
  JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(c.state_county_province, 'No State')
),
total_accounts AS (
  SELECT SUM(account_count) AS total FROM state_accounts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.state,
    sa.account_count,
    sa.account_count * 1.0 / ta.total AS share
  FROM state_accounts sa
  CROSS JOIN total_accounts ta
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares
)
SELECT 
  SUM(s.account_count) AS combined_account_base,
  AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
  AVG(s.share - av.average_share) AS avg_above_average
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avg_share av
WHERE s.share > av.average_share
